subject: The unit-side gunnery pass 00864FE0: the tick sub-node at unit+6DCh that carries the weapon director's stance and its two targets, plus the side's recon contacts, down to every gun the unit owns through 00727F10.
reuses: docs/GUN_BOT_TICKS.md for the gun-bot base 0072BBD0, the attach 008FBC80, the six gun bot slots and the 00727F10 / 00728000 fan-outs
docs/WEAPON_DIRECTOR.md for director+3Ch allowFire, +220h..+223h, +238h fireTarget, vtable[2Ch] = 008364E0 and the ten command slots at +54h
docs/FIXED_STEP_JOB_WAVES.md for 008759B0, the sub-list walker that calls slot +0Ch with 0.05f
docs/ENTITY_CLASS_IDS.md for class id 06h the ship base, 0Fh the plane base, and the 0..60h class-id space that makes 61h a full row
docs/ROBOT_CONFIG.md for load_robot_config_00901610, the producer of the five gun-bot skill descriptors
docs/PROJECTILE_KINDS.md for projectile kind 0Ah Torpedo and 0Bh DepthCharge

answers.caller_and_cadence: 00864FE0 is vtable slot +0Ch of the primary vtable 00D0D360, overriding the gun-bot base's 0071C490 (a bare RET 4). The object is constructed by 00864580 (operator_new(558h)), stored at unit+6DCh and attached to the unit's tick element unit+310h by vtable[+4h] = 00864BD0. docs/FIXED_STEP_JOB_WAVES.md wave 2 has 00875B90 call 008759B0(element, 0.05f), which walks element+1Ch and calls sub->vtable[+0Ch](0.05f). So it runs on every fixed step at dt = 0.05f and self-throttles on this+6Ch >= [GlobalConfig+88h]. Ghidra reports no caller for either the tick or the constructor; the tick is reached only through 00D0D36C and the constructor only through seven direct E8 call sites found by scanning .text.
answers.unit_gun_enumeration: Neither the +48h device list nor the +3D0h/+3CCh root array. The pass reads twelve 0Ch-byte records at unit+394h: +0h is the gate it tests at 0086516D and +4h is the head of a singly linked list (next at +4h, gun at +8h) walked at 00865773. The third word at +39Ch is not read.
answers.what_it_takes_from_the_director: Four things and no others. (1) director+3Ch allowFire and director+3Dh, through the bridge 008624C0 at 008624CB and 008624F4. (2) director+220h..+223h, the four sub-kind flags, through 008624C0 steps 4 to 7 and the four category lists at 00E0A4F8, 00E0A510, 00E0A520 and 00E0A528. (3) director+238h fireTarget, reached through the this+5Ch policy object's slot +4h = 00863640 -> director->vtable[2Ch] = 008364E0, with a fallback to [director+34h]'s ship's own director. (4) the newest of the ten command slots at director+54h, through 0071EBF0 and 00521EA0, and only while [director+30h] == 1. The packet's guess that it reads the +23Ch gate or the +54h command slots directly is wrong: +23Ch is never read here, and the command slots are reached only through 0071EBF0.
answers.party_slot_gate_00927f10: Renamed. 00927F10 is __stdcall(int slot), RET 4, body 00927F10-00927F26, returning the byte at [[00E188A8] + 18CCh + slot*4] + 9. The record is a party slot, not a side, and +9h is 1 when the slot is AI- or mission-held and 0 when a human player holds it. Sole writer found: 004BB220 inside 004BB160. The gate is more often flipped by repointing the slot: FUN_004BB630 points it at a player record (+9 = 0) and FUN_004BB660 points it back at the mission pool (+9 = 1). [gun+1ACh] is the entity's party slot index, defaulted to 8 by BSP_GameEntity_Construct at 00928718; 8 is the no-party sentinel.
answers.gun_634h_bits: Refuted the 'a human is aiming this gun' reading. [gun+3F0h] is the owning unit and +634h is a per-unit scripted fire-inhibit mask: bit 0 AA_Flak, bit 1 Artillery, bit 2 Torpedo, bit 3 DC, from the parameter descriptor literal "All|AA_Flak|Artillery|Torpedo|DC" at 00CE5214. A set bit means hold fire. Every writer is the constructor (0095CE0B, zero) or the two mission-script actions aSetGunFireEnabled 00465290 (clears at 004652E2, 004652FE, 0046531A, 00465336) and aSetGunFireDisabled 00465350 (sets at 004653A5, 004653C1, 004653DD, 004653F9). No player-input, camera or seat-occupancy context appears in any writer.
answers.skill_arrays: Each robot class descriptor is a 0Ch-byte header (vtable, NoTargetTimeUntilRest float written at 00901423, class name pointer) followed by six skill records; every allocation equals 0Ch + 6*stride. The producer is load_robot_config_00901610, which runs Scripts\datatables\Robots.lua and stores the descriptors at 009019EB..00901A53. The six skill levels are Stun 0, SPNormal 1, SPVeteran 2, MPNormal 3, MPVeteran 4, Elite 5 from the key literals at 00D18398..00D183CC. The index reaching a bot is unit+390h through unit->vtable[12Ch] = 006D1EC0, defaulted to 1 at 0095CCCC. Who writes unit+390h from the authored scene property is not established.

corrections.was: Whether bit 1 of [unit+634h] really means a human is aiming this gun; three ticks read three different bits of the same dword.
corrections.is: The four bits are a scripted per-category fire inhibit, set meaning hold fire: bit 0 AA_Flak, bit 1 Artillery, bit 2 Torpedo, bit 3 DC. No writer has any player-input, camera or seat-occupancy context.
corrections.evidence: The parameter descriptor literal "All|AA_Flak|Artillery|Torpedo|DC" at 00CE5214 with the four name literals at 00CE5448..00CE5460; the constructor's zero at 0095CE0B; aSetGunFireEnabled 00465290 clearing at 004652E2, 004652FE, 0046531A and 00465336; aSetGunFireDisabled 00465350 setting at 004653A5, 004653C1, 004653DD and 004653F9; the action names proven from the registration chain at 00462655 and 0046285C.

corrections.document: docs/GUN_BOT_TICKS.md section 5 step 4 and the ledger name for 00927F10
corrections.was: 00927F10 named BSP_Side_AutoEngageEnabled, described as a per-side auto-engage byte.
corrections.is: The expression is right and the meaning is not. The record is a party slot, and +9h is 1 when the slot is AI- or mission-held and 0 when a human player holds it. The gate therefore means the gun's party is not player-controlled.
corrections.evidence: 004BB220 writes 1 inside 004BB160, one iteration per mission-party entry; 0076C86F requires the joining player's record to have +9 == 0 before a claim; FUN_004BB630 and FUN_004BB660 flip the pointer at [game+18CC+slot*4] between the player pool and the mission pool.

corrections.is: 00927F10 is __stdcall with one stack argument and no ECX input, RET 4.
corrections.evidence: Body 00927F10-00927F26 is five instructions: MOV EAX,[ESP+4]; MOV ECX,[00E188A8]; MOV EDX,[ECX+EAX*4+18CCh]; MOV AL,[EDX+9]; RET 4. The call site 008FFA98 is push eax; call 0x927f10 with ECX never loaded.

corrections.was: 00864FE0, the unit-side gunnery pass, which reads the director through entity->vtable[114h]().
corrections.is: It reads the director through unit->vtable[140h]() first, which is 0047F320, an identity cast, and then vtable[114h](). It reads two different targets from the director: the standing fire target through the this+5Ch policy, and the newest command slot through 0071EBF0. director+23Ch and director+3Ch are never read by the tick itself; +3Ch reaches it through the 008624C0 bridge instead.
corrections.evidence: 00865456..0086549C for the chain, 00865442 for the policy call, 0047F320 is mov eax,ecx; ret, and 00863640 is the policy's slot +4h.

corrections.was: Offsets stated against the descriptor pointer because no producer for the array base was read.
corrections.is: The descriptor is a 0Ch-byte header (vtable, NoTargetTimeUntilRest, class name) followed by exactly six skill records, so every documented offset is 0Ch + field. The producer is load_robot_config_00901610 reading Scripts\datatables\Robots.lua.
corrections.evidence: 00901423 writes the +4h float; every allocation equals 0Ch + 6*stride (E4h = 0Ch + 6*24h, 6Ch = 0Ch + 6*10h, B4h = 0Ch + 6*1Ch, 84h = 0Ch + 6*14h); the stores at 009019EB..00901A53 are the only writes to the five globals; the reader 008FCA10 indexes desc + index*24h at 008FCA4C.

corrections.is: They are SectionTargetChance, EngineRoomWeight, MagazineWeight and FueltankWeight, subsystem target weights fed to target->vtable[100h].
corrections.evidence: The Lua key literals at 00D17E90, 00D17E7C, 00D17E6C and 00D17E5C, and the stores at 008FCA65..008FCC0C.
